3. Delivery Instructions for Suppliers/Transporters: I. Delivery Timings & Working Hours: a. IGCAR, Kalpakkam works for 5 days in a Week (Saturday & Sunday are weekly-offs). b. Material delivery can be accepted only in working days (Monday-Friday) excluding Public Holidays betw een 09:00 Hrs, to 15:00 Hrs. c. Supplier/Transporter should report at Main Gate, IGCAR, Kalpakkam well in time, so as to complete the s ecurity checks and deliver the material as per the schedule. In case they reach the Site after 3 pm on any working day or holiday the lorry is liable to be detained overnight till next working day when necessary u nloading facilities could be organized and the consignment unloaded. Please also note that, no detention charges will be payable by us if the Lorries are detained overnight due to the above reasons. II. The Packages should be securely packed and details regarding Purchase Order/GeM Contract reference, complete address of Consignor/Consignee (with Contact details) should be clearly marked on all the packa ges. III. When dispatching multiple orders, material of each order should be packed in separate package, and d etails regarding Order reference should be clearly marked. IV. OTP based deliveries are not possible inside IGCAR/DAE Units. Hence dispatch of material shall be thro ugh standard transporters, WITHOUT OTP. V. In the event of dispatch through Speed Post, the date of actual delivery/physical collection will be consid ered as Delivery Date. VI. The personnel accompanying the supply (visiting IGCAR) should carry valid original Govt ID Proof and d etails of the personnel should be intimated in advance, for arranging entry permit. VII. Drivers should carry original valid Transport Driving License and Vehicles should possess all the requir ed valid Original Road Documents, such as RC, Insurance, Fitness and etc., otherwise the vehicles will not be permitted inside plant for delivery. VIII. Vehicles with GPS tracking are not permitted inside DAE Units. IX. Prior intimation/communication has to be sent to the consignee, well in advance, with complete details of material including Purchase Order/GeM Contract Number, No of Packages, Volume & weight and contact details of transporter/driver by email. X. Contact Details for advance intimation regarding delivery: a. For BARCF: i. Tel Nos: 044-27480244/27303993/3994 (Direct) and ii. Board: 044-27480500 Extension: 43993/43994

iii. Email-IDs: asowip@igcar.gov.in&stores@igcar.gov.in NOTE: Bidder shall furnish their compliance to the technical specification as per bid parameters with absolute values offered by them in their letterhead duly stamped & signed, failing which offer will be rejected. .
